seo.description: Fifteen CHUWU fragrances, three for each of the Five Elements — Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water — in 10ml and 30ml.

signature.title: Five Scents, Five Intentions
signature.lede: No reading required. Each signature blend is composed around the Five Elements associated with a specific intention — pick the one that speaks to what you need most right now.

element_scents.title: Scents for Every Element
element_scents.lede: Three scents for each of the Five Elements. Already know which element you're missing? Pick yours here — or take a free Bazi reading to find out.

personalized.title: Personalize Your Own Blend
personalized.lede: Take a short Bazi reading and build a fragrance around exactly what your chart needs — choose your own notes, we bottle it just for you.
